name: Pandharpur–Kurduvadi National Highway
significance: NH 965C is a branch of NH 965. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Pandharpur to Kurduvadi, and it meets NH 965 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 965 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Akluj to Gopalpatti
